import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

class Main {

    static class Edge {
        int from;
        int to;
        double length;

        Edge(int f, int t, double l) {
            this.from = f;
            this.to = t;
            this.length = l;
        }
    }

    static class Node {
        List<Integer> out = new ArrayList<>();
    }

    static class Graph {
        List<Node> nodes = new ArrayList<>();
        List<Edge> edges = new ArrayList<>();

        Graph(int nr_nodes, int nr_edges) {
            for (int i = 0; i < nr_nodes; i++) {
                nodes.add(new Node());
            }
            // edges list initial capacity not critical here
        }

        void add_edge(int from, int to, double length) {
            Edge e = new Edge(from, to, length);
            edges.add(e);
            nodes.get(from).out.add(edges.size() - 1);
        }

        List<Integer> find_augmenting_path(int source, int sink, double[] flow, double[] path_cap) {
            PriorityQueue<Pair> q = new PriorityQueue<>(Collections.reverseOrder());
            double[] capacity = new double[nodes.size()];
            int[] pred = new int[nodes.size()];
            Arrays.fill(pred, -1);
            Arrays.fill(capacity, 0.0);
            capacity[source] = Double.POSITIVE_INFINITY;
            q.add(new Pair(Double.POSITIVE_INFINITY, source));

            while (!q.isEmpty() && capacity[sink] == 0) {
                Pair current = q.poll();
                double cap = current.first;
                int n = current.second;

                for (int e_idx : nodes.get(n).out) {
                    Edge e = edges.get(e_idx);
                    double e_cap = e.length - flow[e_idx];

                    if (e_cap > 0 && Math.min(cap, e_cap) > capacity[e.to]) {
                        capacity[e.to] = Math.min(cap, e_cap);
                        pred[e.to] = e_idx;
                        q.remove(new Pair(capacity[e.to], e.to));
                        q.add(new Pair(capacity[e.to], e.to));
                    }
                }
            }

            List<Integer> path = new ArrayList<>();
            path_cap[0] = capacity[sink];
            int e_idx = pred[sink];
            while (e_idx != -1) {
                path.add(e_idx);
                e_idx = pred[edges.get(e_idx).from];
            }
            return path;
        }

        double max_flow(int source, int sink) {
            int maxEdges = 2 * edges.size();
            Graph residual = new Graph(nodes.size(), maxEdges);
            double[] flow = new double[maxEdges];
            double[] path_cap = new double[1];

            for (Edge e : edges) {
                residual.add_edge(e.from, e.to, e.length);
                residual.add_edge(e.to, e.from, 0);
            }

            List<Integer> path = residual.find_augmenting_path(source, sink, flow, path_cap);
            while (path_cap[0] > 0) {
                for (int e_idx : path) {
                    int e_ridx = e_idx + 1;
                    if (e_idx % 2 == 1) e_ridx = e_idx - 1;
                    flow[e_idx] += path_cap[0];
                    flow[e_ridx] -= path_cap[0];
                }
                path = residual.find_augmenting_path(source, sink, flow, path_cap);
            }

            double maxFlow = 0;
            for (int e_idx : nodes.get(source).out) {
                maxFlow += flow[e_idx];
            }
            return maxFlow;
        }

        void print_all() {
            for (int i = 0; i < nodes.size(); i++) {
                System.out.print(id_to_string(i) + " has edges to : ");
                for (Integer e_idx : nodes.get(i).out) {
                    System.out.print(id_to_string(edges.get(e_idx).to) + " ");
                }
                System.out.println();
            }
        }
    }

    static class Pair implements Comparable<Pair> {
        double first;
        int second;

        Pair(double f, int s) {
            this.first = f;
            this.second = s;
        }

        @Override
        public int compareTo(Pair o) {
            return Double.compare(this.first, o.first);
        }

        @Override
        public boolean equals(Object o) {
            if (this == o) return true;
            if (!(o instanceof Pair)) return false;
            Pair p = (Pair) o;
            return Double.compare(p.first, first) == 0 && p.second == second;
        }

        @Override
        public int hashCode() {
            return Objects.hash(first, second);
        }
    }

    static class Room {
        int i, j;
        boolean[] infected = new boolean[61];
        boolean[] accessible = new boolean[61];
        int scientists;
        int capsules;

        Room() {
            Arrays.fill(infected, false);
            Arrays.fill(accessible, true);
            this.scientists = 0;
            this.capsules = 0;
        }

        int get_node_id(int timestamp, int n) {
            return 2 + i + n * j + (n * n) * timestamp;
        }

        void set_reactor() {
            Arrays.fill(accessible, false);
        }

        void set_infected(int timestamp) {
            if (accessible[timestamp]) {
                accessible[timestamp] = false;
                infected[timestamp] = true;
            }
        }
    }

    static Room[][] floorplan;
    static int n, t;

    static String id_to_string(int id) {
        if (id == 0) return "source";
        if (id == 1) return "sink";
        StringBuilder ss = new StringBuilder();
        int row = (id - 2) % n;
        int col = ((id - 2 - row) % (n * n)) / n;
        int timestamp = (id - 2 - row - col * n) / (n * n);
        ss.append("(").append(row).append(",").append(col).append(",").append(timestamp).append(")");
        return ss.toString();
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        String[] parts = br.readLine().split(" ");
        n = Integer.parseInt(parts[0]);
        t = Integer.parseInt(parts[1]);

        floorplan = new Room[n][n];

        // Read scientist locations
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            String line = br.readLine();
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                if (floorplan[i][j] == null)
                    floorplan[i][j] = new Room();
                floorplan[i][j].i = i;
                floorplan[i][j].j = j;
                char c = line.charAt(j);
                if (c == 'Y') {
                    floorplan[i][j].set_reactor();
                } else if (c == 'Z') {
                    floorplan[i][j].set_infected(0);
                } else {
                    floorplan[i][j].scientists = c - '0';
                }
            }
        }

        // Read capsule locations
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            String line = br.readLine();
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                if (floorplan[i][j].scientists != -1) {
                    // Already assigned
                }
                char c = line.charAt(j);
                if (c != 'Y' && c != 'Z') {
                    floorplan[i][j].capsules = c - '0';
                }
            }
        }

        // Spread infection over time
        for (int c = 0; c <= t; c++) {
            for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
                for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                    if (c < t)
                        floorplan[i][j].spread_infection(c);
                }
            }
        }

        Graph g = new Graph(n * n * (t + 1) + 2, 100 * 4 * 60);
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                final Room room = floorplan[i][j];
                if (room.scientists > 0)
                    g.add_edge(0, room.get_node_id(0, n), room.scientists);
                if (room.capsules > 0)
                    g.add_edge(room.get_node_id(t, n), 1, room.capsules);

                for (int c = 0; c < t; c++) {
                    if (room.capsules > 0)
                        g.add_edge(room.get_node_id(c, n), room.get_node_id(t, n), 1000);
                    if (room.accessible[c]) {
                        if (i > 0) {
                            Room other = floorplan[i - 1][j];
                            if (other.accessible[c]) g.add_edge(room.get_node_id(c, n), other.get_node_id(c + 1, n), 1000);
                        }
                        if (i < n - 1) {
                            Room other = floorplan[i + 1][j];
                            if (other.accessible[c]) g.add_edge(room.get_node_id(c, n), other.get_node_id(c + 1, n), 1000);
                        }
                        if (j > 0) {
                            Room other = floorplan[i][j - 1];
                            if (other.accessible[c]) g.add_edge(room.get_node_id(c, n), other.get_node_id(c + 1, n), 1000);
                        }
                        if (j < n - 1) {
                            Room other = floorplan[i][j + 1];
                            if (other.accessible[c]) g.add_edge(room.get_node_id(c, n), other.get_node_id(c + 1, n), 1000);
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        // System.out.println("Graph edges:");
        // g.print_all();

        System.out.println((int) g.max_flow(0, 1));
    }
}
